title: A History of the Freedom Movement, Volume III: 1906–1936
note: Volume III of the five-volume history edited by the Board of Editors of the Pakistan Historical Society, chaired by Mahmud Husain. The digitized Delhi reprint is marked “First Published 1960” and “Reprinted 1984”; its cover incorrectly labels the volume “1831–1905, Part I,” although the contents include 1905 and Chapter V, “The Lucknow Pact,” by Dr. Mahmud Husain, on 1916. Catalog records identify Volume III as 1906–1936. The series was originally published in Karachi by the Pakistan Historical Society during 1957–1970; a library record dates Volume III to 1963. Part designation for this scan is unverified.
whyItMatters: Its dedicated chapter records the Lucknow scheme’s Bengal allocation and a contemporary historiographical assessment of how that formula affected Muslim representation in a Muslim-majority province.
